title: 'Axelrod', ONI Nimitz investigator, studying Skinwalker Ranch

tellings.quote: they have this guy, I think his name is Axelrod, he's a pseudonym and he sort of studies the phenomena, but he was the chief um Office of Naval Intelligence investigator on the Nimitz case in 2004 and he's, you know, showing up at Skinwalker Ranch and studying this stuff.

plain: A man known by the made-up name Axelrod is said to study strange events at Skinwalker Ranch, a ranch in Utah known for reports of odd happenings. Michels says Axelrod was the lead investigator for the Office of Naval Intelligence, the US Navy's intelligence service, on the Nimitz case. That case covers the 2004 sightings of unexplained objects by Navy pilots flying from the aircraft carrier Nimitz. Michels says this himself, in an episode with the ranch's owner, without naming a source, and to him it suggests that the same officials who looked into the Navy sightings are now looking at the ranch.
